name: Ano Hi Mita Yuuhi
source:
2020, Japan. Boring everyday. Uninspired days. The world is still as rotten as ever.

I wish that everything would break down anyway.

Even if I thought about that, I guess life would go on unchanged.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2020年，日本。百无聊赖的日常，乏善可陈的岁月，这个世界依旧一如既往地腐朽不堪。

真希望干脆一切都彻底崩坏算了。

可就算脑子里这么想，日子大概还是会毫无波澜地照旧过下去吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258930/]Steam[/url]]
